arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Justice Alito questioned if the officer's observation of the driving was the real problem.
Justice Kennedy asked what happens under the driver's view after the stop ends.
Justice Scalia asked if the driver requested suppression of the fruit of the stop.
Justice Ginsburg asked if any case suppressed information lawfully in government possession.

sections.heading: What each side wants
paragraphs: New York wants to use the DMV records to prove the driver had a suspended license.
The driver wants the court to throw out the DMV records because the stop was illegal.
